summary: community.general deprecations: defining debug in MH subclasses; atomic_container/host/image (13.0.0); facter (use facter_facts, 12.0.0); locale_gen ubuntu_mode/ubuntu_legacy; the proxmox update default becoming true; and the pure module utils and purestorage doc fragments.
questions: Will proxmox update default to true?

answer_card.title: community.general deprecations (11.2.0)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `facter` will be removed in 12.0.0. Use `community.general.facter_facts`.
- `atomic_container`, `atomic_host`, `atomic_image` will be removed in 13.0.0.
- `locale_gen`: `ubuntu_mode=True` / `mechanism=ubuntu_legacy` will be removed in 13.0.0.
- `proxmox`: the `update` default changes to `true` in 11.0.0. Set it explicitly.
- The `pure` module utils and purestorage doc fragments are deprecated.
